verses.text: The seed on good soil stands for those . . . who hear the word, retain it, and . . . produce a crop.
verses.title: Slow, Patient Growth in God

verses.text: It is the Lord your God you must follow, and him you must revere. Keep his commands and obey him; serve him and hold fast to him.
Whatever you have learned or received or heard from me, or seen in me—put it into practice. And the God of peace will be with you.
